title: Research fields, cost progression and miniaturization

provenance.note: Costs rise in a Fibonacci-like series plus 10 resources per field per level.

provenance.location: TOPICPOS 640900 (0x0009c784), HLP file offset 165241 (0x00028579), topic 71 'Conditions that Affect Production'
provenance.note: Miniaturization 4% per level to 75%, or 5% to 80% with Bleeding Edge.

provenance.location: TOPICPOS 1870558 (0x001c8ade), HLP file offset 473299 (0x000738d3), topic 287 'Step 6: Research Costs (Player Race)'

setup.baseline: A race with standard research costs and no relevant trait.
setup.variable: Field, current level, allocated resources and research-cost choice.

procedure: Record the six fields and starting levels.
For each field, record the resource cost of the next level at levels 0-10 and compare to the documented progression.
Change the percentage allocation and record the next-level estimate.
Test each of the three cost choices and the all-fields starting-tech box.
Design a component at two different tech levels and record miniaturized cost.

documented: Six fields: Energy, Weapons, Propulsion, Construction, Electronics and Biotechnology; levels 0-26; one field at a time (documented-only).
Research cost increases in a Fibonacci-like series plus 10 resources per field per level already achieved (documented-only).
Miniaturization reduces production cost 4% per level above requirement, capped at 75%; Bleeding Edge uses 5% and caps at 80% (documented-only).
Step 6 choices are Costs 75% extra, standard, and Costs 50% less for each field; All Costs 75% Extra starts those fields at tech 3 (tech 4 with Jack of All Trades) (documented-only).

unresolved: Exact Fibonacci base and rounding are not stated.
The help gives 5% in one topic and 4% in another for normal miniaturization; the version-specific value must be measured.
Whether Generalised Research changes the cost base or only distribution is unknown.
